Celebrations

Star cottage cheesecake

Csillag túrótorta

12 months+ Adjusted 55 min 8 portions

Occasional, from 12 months. Keep everyday milk, egg, and gluten in other meals a few times a week once each is tolerated. Try a first new allergen in the morning on a well day, not in this whole cake.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 80 g rolled oats (ground; soft base, listed as gluten)
  • 1 tbsp rapeseed or olive oil (binds the base without sugar)
  • 90 g plain pasteurized yogurt (1 tbsp in the base and the rest in the filling)
  • 200 g pasteurized cottage cheese (unsalted and unsweetened)
  • 1 egg (baked until fully set)
  • a few pieces soft fruit (on top instead of glaze)

Allergens

milkegggluten

Method

  1. Stir the ground oats with the oil and a spoon of yogurt, then press a thin base into a small tin.
  2. Bake the base at 180 C for about 8 minutes.
  3. Beat the cottage cheese, egg, and remaining yogurt until smooth.
  4. Pour the cheese over the base and bake until the egg is fully set and the middle is still soft.
  5. Cool, cut soft stars, and leave any dry edge aside.
  6. Top with soft fruit, not a sugar glaze.

Adjusted

A sugar glaze turns this into a sweet, and it is only an occasional cake.

Bake a no-sugar cheesecake of cottage cheese, egg, and yogurt on a soft oat base, and cut it into stars. Put fruit on top, not a sugar glaze.
